title: Artifact plan model and blocker taxonomy
description:
Build a pure, serializable artifact-plan domain model that is the single input to preview rendering and execution. Schema version 1 has exactly these envelope fields: `schema_version`, `target`, `destination_root`, `operation_id`, `operation_instance_id`, `execution_id`, `plan_fingerprint`, `eligible`, `policy_status`, `counts`, `artifact_count`, `artifacts`, `blockers`, `warnings`. Each artifact has exactly: `source`, `version`, `content_identity`, `destination`, `action`, `destination_provenance`, `publication_required`, `publication_mapping`, `publication_proof`, `already_archived`, `provenance`, `format`, `owners`, `edges`, `reference_changes`, `pending_deletions`, `evidence`, `blockers`, `warnings`. Evidence codes are `permanent-path`, `outside-owner`, `active-owner`, `unmanaged-path`, `archived-source`, `pinned-historical`. Blocker codes are `policy-unconfigured`, `policy-incomplete`, `unmanaged-selected-root`, `destination-conflict`, `document-non-terminal-owner`, `pinned-read-failed`, `unsupported-dynamic-edge`, `repository-escape`, `unresolvable-edge`, `unpreservable-layout`, `non-terminal-target`, `missing-source`, `symlink-artifact`, `archive-recovery-blocked`, `quarantine-unavailable`, `archive-recovery-ambiguous`. Warning codes are `missing-edge-target`, `external-edge`, `no-owner`, `residue-source`, `deletion-failed`, `not-selected-sibling`, `quarantined-foreign-file`. Artifact identity is normalized path plus `working-tree` or canonical full immutable commit OID. Codes are stable and append-only under explicit schema versioning; policy defaults may be displayed but never authorize execution.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Serializing the same plan from any permutation of equivalent inputs produces identical artifact ordering by normalized source path then version and identical blocker/warning ordering by code then path.
- [hard] REQ-02: Preview rendering and execution accept the same plan type; neither maintains a second classification model.
- [hard] REQ-03: Successfully resolved pinned artifacts serialize, sort, compare, and fingerprint only by canonical full immutable commit OID as non-relocating historical entries; failed revision resolution or commit-specific reads produce `pinned-read-failed`.
- [hard] REQ-04: `policy_status` is `configured` only when `[documentation]` explicitly supplies `managed_paths`, `permanent_paths`, and `archive_root`; missing and partial policy serialize as `unconfigured` and `incomplete`, and accessor defaults never make either executable.
- [hard] REQ-05: Every working-tree publication source or planned deletion carries `content_identity` with a 64-character lowercase SHA-256 and exact `byte_size`; `ArchiveStarted` model fields bind that identity to exact source, destination, reference-change, publication, and deletion entries.
- [hard] REQ-06: A golden schema-version-1 conformance test asserts the complete envelope/artifact field lists and evidence/blocker/warning code lists above; a missing, renamed, extra, or reclassified field/code fails unless accompanied by an explicit schema-versioning decision.
